hunks.sol: Sama Pyo had come out to the clearing in front of the quarters to train when a thought occurred to him.

hunks.baseline: Was he simply born unlucky, or had the karma from that damn Pavilion Master’s misdeeds flowed all the way here like a stream?
hunks.sol: Was he born unlucky, or had the consequences of that damn Pavilion Master’s misdeeds flowed all the way here like a stream?

hunks.baseline: “And so I ask you…”
hunks.sol: “So let me ask you.”

hunks.baseline: The Black Dragon Saber emerged with a cold ring.
hunks.sol: The Black Dragon Saber slid free with a cold ring. Sama Pyo stepped forward, his favored weapon in hand.

hunks.baseline: Sama Pyo took a step forward with his treasured weapon in hand and continued.
